chapters.label: Live
chapters.text: Munich, 1974, the World Cup final. West Germany lead the Netherlands two-one. After half-time, the Dutch attack again and again. Johnny Rep shoots... Sepp Maier springs across and pushes it away!

chapters.label: The replay
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Maier waits low, on his toes. Rep strikes it. Maier pushes off, flies sideways and turns it away!

chapters.label: Again and again
chapters.text: The TV commentator shouted, “Maier! Again and again, Maier!” West Germany held on to win.

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: They called him the Cat. Your turn: stay low and light on your feet, so you can react like a cat!
